summary: Frontend-only regression for the mobile UI redesign of Facilita AI at https://smart-tools-49.preview.emergentagent.com. Tested at viewports 360x780, 390x844 and tablet 768x1024. Verified: bottom-nav has exactly 4 items (nav-home, nav-tools, nav-history, nav-profile) with active color #ff5722, safe-area padding-bottom respected, AdBanner returns null (no ESPAÇO PUBLICITÁRIO / no ad-banner-placeholder), typography sizes on target (card strong=16px, small=13px, section h2=19px, home h1=31.2px), touch targets meet spec (tool_main 92h, favorite_btn 56w x 92h, nav item 58.5h). Regression: admin login OK, usage badge reads 'Você tem 3 usos grátis hoje', QR preview renders, /premium shows plan-free + plan-premium + R$ and subscribe button, /perfil shows usage-summary, /admin accessible for admin. Found ONE critical horizontal overflow bug on Home (soon-grid items pushing scrollWidth to 497 at 390px viewport and 493 at 360px) — root-caused to grid items without min-width:0 letting long tool names + 'EM BREVE' tag push width beyond track. Applied minimal CSS fix (min-width:0; overflow:hidden on .soon-item) and re-verified: all six routes and all three viewports now report scrollWidth === clientWidth.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: Grid items without min-width:0 caused horizontal overflow — at 390px viewport scrollWidth was 497 (107px overflow), at 360px scrollWidth was 493 (133px). Long tool names ('Criar currículo', 'Calculadora de desconto') combined with the 'EM BREVE' small tag (margin-left:auto, no wrap) forced each .soon-item to ~197px in a 2-col grid, breaking the layout. Applied min-width:0 + overflow:hidden on .soon-item. All viewports now clean.

action_items: Confirm the .soon-item CSS fix (min-width:0; overflow:hidden) is acceptable — it does not alter visual design, only prevents overflow. Optionally consider ellipsis on the tool name span for very long labels (already applied via white-space:nowrap + text-overflow:ellipsis on .soon-item>span).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~690 lines with many components — consider splitting Home/Tools/ToolPage/Profile/Premium/Admin into separate files for maintainability (>700 lines threshold approaching).

AdBanner returns null unconditionally right now — that's fine as an interim (matches product decision), but the useAppSettings() call still hits /api/settings on every mount from every AdBanner instance. When SDK is wired, consider memoizing settings via context to avoid duplicate calls (Home + ToolPage both mount AdBanner).

Bottom nav on ToolPage / Favorites uses active='tools' and active='favorites' but 'favorites' is no longer in the 4-item nav — that active flag is now a no-op. Small cleanup: change to active='tools' or 'profile' as appropriate.

History page: BottomNav is inside the app-shell but the outer <BottomNav active='history'/> is fine; however Favorites page still uses <BottomNav active='favorites'/> which will never match any item — cosmetic only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (11/11 checks pass: bottom-nav 4 items, ad-banner clean, typography, touch targets, active color, mobile 360 no overflow, mobile 390 no overflow, tablet 768 2-col + no overflow, login + usage badge '3 usos grátis', qrcode preview, /premium plans + R$, /perfil usage-summary, /admin admin access, safe-area padding-bottom present via calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)))

context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign of mobile UI is stable. All viewports (360/390/768) render without horizontal overflow after the .soon-item min-width:0 fix. Bottom-nav is 4-item (nav-favorites removed) with orange active state. AdBanner is stubbed to return null. If retesting, remember to dismiss welcome modal via [data-testid='welcome-dismiss-button'] or clear localStorage 'facilita_welcome_dismissed'. Admin credentials work; free_daily_limit stays at 3. Favorites page still exists at /favoritos by URL only.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the horizontal overflow bug: `.soon-item` is a flex container inside a 2-column CSS grid. CSS grid items default to `min-width: auto` (which is 'min-content'). Because .soon-item contained a <span> with tool label + a <small> with 'EM BREVE' that used `white-space:nowrap` and `margin-left:auto`, the min-content width of each grid item became ~197px. Two 197px items + 10px gap = 404px, exceeding a 390px viewport (or 358px content area after 16px page padding). Reproduction: open Home at 390 or 360px, scroll horizontally — page scrolls right by ~110px, exposing dark background. Mitigation applied: added `min-width:0; overflow:hidden` to `.soon-item` so the flex/grid track cannot expand beyond the assigned 1fr; the inner <span> already has ellipsis so long labels truncate gracefully.
